title: Company Calendar
subtitle: Business deadlines, obligations and commitments — with clear ownership.
dateHelp: Date-only deadlines stay in the selected timezone. For timed appointments, clear the business date and enter timestamps with an explicit offset, such as +02:00. All-day appointments require an exclusive end date. Targets and forecasts do not replace the hard deadline.
sharingHelp: Team, restricted and private items are visible only to the creator, owner and selected people. Domain permissions still apply. Company managers do not automatically see private items.
historyRestricted: Detailed history is available to the owner and creator.
scoreHelp: Attention uses explainable rules for proximity, priority, ownership, preparation and evidence. It is not a probability or an AI prediction.
truncatedHorizon: This view summarizes the first 1,000 authorized active items. Narrow the filters for complete counts.
pageHelp: Calendar and timeline show the current page; use page controls to see more dates.
empty: No business dates in this view
emptyHelp: Add an obligation, deadline or commitment, or adjust your filters.
accessRequired: Select a company with Company Calendar read permission.
disabled: Company Calendar is disabled. An administrator must apply the calendar schema, grant module permissions and enable the calendar feature.
microsoftUnconnected: Microsoft 365 is not connected. Outlook synchronization and Teams meeting creation are unavailable.

microsoft.title: Microsoft 365 / Outlook
microsoft.description: Calendar connection requires Entra application registration, delegated consent, encrypted token storage and a public HTTPS webhook. No calendars are read or invitations sent in this release.

ai.title: AI Brief / Candidate Inbox
ai.description: Rule-based attention is available in Horizon. AI extraction and candidate approval are reserved for a later integration phase; no binding obligations are created by AI.

teams.title: Microsoft Teams
teams.description: Teams meetings will use Outlook calendar events after Microsoft integration. Native Teams tabs and notifications require tenant setup.

rules.title: Verified legal rule library
rules.description: No statutory deadlines are preloaded. Record verified business dates manually. Legal rule review, holiday calendars and automated reminders require a later release.
